save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with epoch, test error, and optimizer state to disk
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint file and restore model weights and optimizer state from disk
delete_checkpoints: delete unneeded checkpoint files keeping all, last, or none based on the keep setting
get_last_checkpoint: retrieve the path to the most recent checkpoint file by highest epoch number
has_checkpoint: check if any checkpoint files exist in the configured checkpoints directory
